instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/part_ref.step in BRL-CAD. Generate an inspection fixture block from the reference part: create an envelope block that adds 4 mm total clearance in X, Y, and Z around the 110 x 56 x 18 mm reference bounding box; subtract the reference-body cavity while adding 2 mm total clamping clearance; cut one guide hole of diameter 8 mm on each side, with hole axes along Y. The two guide hole centerlines are on the reference height midplane at Z=9 mm and Y=28 mm, located 15 mm from the reference part X end faces, so their X positions are X=15 mm and X=95 mm. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). Before starting the work, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `part_ref.step`.
